messages.content: What is the align attribute in HTML?
The align attribute in HTML is used to specify the alignment of text within a paragraph. It can have values like 'left', 'center', or 'right'.

What are the core attributes in HTML?
The core attributes in HTML are 'id', 'title', 'class', and 'style'. These attributes are used on most HTML elements.
What is the purpose of the id attribute in HTML?
The id attribute is used to uniquely identify an HTML element. It can be used to reference the element in CSS or JavaScript.
What are the two primary reasons to use an id attribute on an HTML element?
To identify a unique element and its content, or to distinguish between elements with the same name.
What is the syntax for the title attribute in HTML?
The title attribute syntax is similar to that of the id attribute.
What is the behavior of the title attribute in HTML?
It often displays as a tooltip when the cursor comes over the element or while it is loading.
What are the internationalization attributes available for most XHTML elements?
There are three internationalization attributes available for most (although not all) XHTML elements. They are: lang, dir, and xml:lang.
What are the internationalization attributes available for most XHTML elements?
There are three internationalization attributes available for most (although not all) XHTML elements. They are: lang, dir, and xml:lang.
What is the dir attribute used for in HTML?
The dir attribute is used to indicate the direction in which the text should flow in an HTML document.
What are the two values that the dir attribute can take?
The dir attribute can take two values: ltr (left to right) and rtl (right to left).
How is the dir attribute used within the <html> tag?
When used within the <html> tag, the dir attribute determines how text will be presented within the entire document.
What is the purpose of the lang attribute in HTML?
The lang attribute was kept in HTML only for backwards compatibility with earlier versions of HTML, but it has been replaced by the xml:lang attribute in new XHTML documents.
What is the ISO-639 standard two-character language code for English?
The ISO-639 standard two-character language code for English is 'en'.
What is the difference between the lang attribute and the xml:lang attribute in HTML?
The lang attribute is the XHTML replacement for the lang attribute. The value of the xml:lang attribute should be an ISO-639 country code as mentioned in previous section.
What are some generic attributes that can be used with many HTML tags?
Some generic attributes that can be used with many HTML tags include align, valign, bgcolor, background, and id.
What are the different HTML tags mentioned in the text?

What does the 'class' attribute do in HTML?
The 'class' attribute is used to classify an element for use with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).
What is the purpose of the 'width' attribute in HTML?
The 'width' attribute specifies the width of tables, images, or table cells.
What is the 'height' attribute in HTML?
The 'height' attribute specifies the height of tables, images, or table cells.
What does the 'title' attribute do in HTML?
The 'title' attribute provides a 'pop-up' title of the elements.
What is the difference between bold text and italicized text in HTML?
Bold text is displayed in bold using the ... element, while italicized text is displayed in italic using the ... element.
What are the different types of text formatting in HTML?
HTML provides several ways to format text, including italic, underline, and strikethrough. These are achieved using the <i>, <u>, and <strike> tags respectively.
How do you apply italic formatting to text in HTML?
To apply italic formatting to text in HTML, you use the tag. For example, italicized text.
What is the difference between <i> and <em> tags in HTML?
Both <i> and <em> tags are used to emphasize text, but <em> is more commonly used for emphasis, while <i> is used for italics.
How do you apply underline formatting to text in HTML?
To apply underline formatting to text in HTML, you use the <u> tag. For example, <u>underlined text</u>.
What is the difference between <u> and <ins> tags in HTML?
Both <u> and <ins> tags are used to indicate inserted text, but <ins> is more commonly used for inserted text, while <u> is used for underlining.
How do you apply strikethrough formatting to text in HTML?
To apply strikethrough formatting to text in HTML, you use the <strike> tag. For example, <strike>strikethrough text</strike>.
What is the difference between <strike> and <del> tags in HTML?
Both <strike> and <del> tags are used to indicate deleted text, but <del> is more commonly used for deleted text, while <strike> is used for strikethrough.
What is the purpose of the <tt>...</tt> element in HTML?
The <tt>...</tt> element is used to write text in monospaced font.
What is the difference between a variable-width font and a monospaced font?
A variable-width font has different widths for different letters, while a monospaced font has the same width for all letters.
What is the purpose of the <sup>...</sup> element in HTML?
The <sup>...</sup> element is used to write text in superscript.
What is the purpose of the <sub>...</sub> element in HTML?
The <sub>...</sub> element is used to write text in subscript.
What is the difference between <sub> and <ins> elements in HTML?
The <sub> element is used to display text as subscript, while the <ins> element is used to display text as inserted text.
How does the <big> element work in HTML?
The <big> element increases the font size of the text it contains relative to the surrounding text.
What is the purpose of the <del> element in HTML?
The <del> element is used to display text as deleted or removed text.
